items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Dutre was over there with Carol Dixon's band.

ctx.x: It was a company, wasn't it? John Wycliffe.

Yeah, John Wycliffe had the band entertainers. And the Deluxe and the Dreamin' was open. Then you had Jimmy Loom and the Vendome was going big. And Louie was doubling. Later on, before Louie came back, then he doubled from the Vendome. The Vendome to the Sunset. That's when Natty Dominic was playing there with him, you understand? And Dutre. All those bands split up and the men just went like the Four Wings. Dutre was over there with Carol Dixon's band. So I may be in some instances, I may be a little ahead of…

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Now, I was with Carol Dixon at the Grand Terrace

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And that's what Frankie Halfbint used to advertise. Yeah.

On the radio. Well, he had a good chance. We broadcast one night. And I don't know, it's just like I said at Titanes. We rehearsed before then and the man sounded good. But when we got on the air, it sounded all together different. And it seems like some people, Titans up, you know, to get those butterflies in here, you know? And they just don't produce as well as if you was playing for a dance or a live. Loose. Just like playing music note for note and playing without the music. Yeah. Well, you just can relax,…
